  "task": "Use Help Scout as a task management platform for a small team.",
  "benefits": [
    "Track tickets simply",
    "Assign and close tasks easily",
    "Integrate with other applications",
    "Stay organized with projects and small tasks"
  ],
  "frictions": [
    "Lack of detailed reporting",
    "Inability to get full reports on each team member",
    "Cannot see how long each task took each team member",
    "Difficulty seeing reporting details at a glance"
  ]
}
